facts.fact: Tom Allen was born in Birmingham, England.
Tom Allen fought Joe Goss in March 1867, and his right shoulder was dislocated in the 25th round, but he fought on; he was then 27 years old and 5 feet 10 inches tall.
After the 1867 fight a mob attacked Tom Allen, and he was shot in the hand and hit in the eye with a club.
Coburn knocked Tom Allen off the stage at the Bowery Theater in 1868, slightly injuring him.
Tom Allen's brother Harry Allen was matched to fight Joe Goss for £400 and the championship of England on September 4, 1868, and Harry died soon after the planned fight was stopped.
The paper gave Tom Allen's age as 28 at the time of a fight on January 12, 1869.
Tom Allen was knocked senseless on February 23, 1869, and lay unconscious until Looney doctored him; he was then 28 years old, 5 feet 9 inches tall and weighed 168 pounds.
After a June 1869 fight Tom Allen, reported as 28 years old, had only a slight abrasion of the lower lip.
In June 1869 Tom Allen's English sweetheart was reported to be joining him, and to be going with him toward St. Louis to marry him.
facts.conflict: place: she would meet him at Vincennes (333.c2) vs she went with him toward St. Louis, her family having settled in New York State (331.c6)

facts.fact: In 1869 Tom Allen said he had declared his intention to become a United States citizen two years earlier, and in August 1869 he claimed to be an American citizen and said he would fight under American colors.
Tom Allen was said to be sick at the time of the July 1869 meeting for drawing up the articles of his fight with Mike McCoole.
Tom Allen fought Charley Gallagher at Chouteau Island on August 17, 1869, and a shot struck the back of his right hand.
Tom Allen was very sick for about a week before December 16, 1869, and was confined to his house.
Tom Allen fought Jem Mace at New Orleans on May 10, 1870, and was injured in the fight.
facts.conflict: arm: injured (195.c9) vs broken (909.c12); a surgeon found the shoulder was not dislocated, only cramped muscles (401.c2); neck feared broken (096.c8); few marks shown after the fight (406.c2); age 27 (228.c6)

facts.fact: Tom Allen has a sister who teaches school in Corydon, Indiana.
The paper gave Tom Allen's age as about 37 in June 1870.
facts.conflict: conflicts with the age of 27 given for May 1870 (228.c6) and 28 given for 1869

facts.fact: On June 10, 1873, Tom Allen weighed about 200 pounds and was in good health.
Tom Allen fought Mike McCoole on September 23, 1873, and a knuckle on his right hand was slightly cut.
Tom Allen and Ben Hogan fought on October 28, 1873, and both were in excellent condition on the day of the fight; Allen weighed 172 pounds stripped on October 24.
Tom Allen was struck with a rock before the Edwards-Collyer fight in August 1874 but received no damage from it.
